newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat's Punto 1997 top selling car in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Fiat's Punto 1997 top selling car in Europe.

text.p: Fiat Auto's Punto small car was Europe's best selling car in the first five months of 1997 with sales in the January-May period of 276,000, motor industry sources said on Tuesday.
The sources added that the Golf, made by Germany's Volkswagen and Europe's top selling car for a number of years, registered some 22,000 less sales than the Punto in the first five months of 1997.

Fiat was Europe's fifth largest mass-market car manufacturer in 1996 with a market share of 11.2 percent, but this year helped by a Italian government backed car buying incentive scheme sales have boomed in Italy, pushing it into second place in Europe behind Volkswagen with a market share of 12.6 percent in the first five months of 1997.
